question: Does the constant-rate interacting-vacuum background Q=Gamma*rho_x, w_x=-1, improve the released 13-row DESI DR2 BAO profile over nested flat LCDM?
hypothesis: A low-dimensional interaction may alter late-time distance ratios enough to improve the full-covariance profile; any improvement must be compared to a matched finite-search flat-null calibration.
assumptions_and_units: Use the source paper's sign convention: Q>0 transfers CDM to DE; fitted negative Gamma means DE-to-CDM.
Flat homogeneous background only; radiation, neutrino evolution, perturbations, growth and CMB are omitted from this profile screen.
BAO nuisance alpha=c/(H0*rd) is profiled freely and dimensionless; H0, rd, and dimensional Gamma are not separately identified.
Baryons are conserved separately. Their split from CDM is not identified by homogeneous BAO and is accepted only when a positive split exists through z<=2.33.
Search bounds are numerical domains, not priors. No Bayesian posterior, evidence, or significance is computed.
environment_lock: Python 3.12.3, NumPy 2.5.3, SciPy 1.18.1; project .venv; Linux x86_64

nuisance_parameters.f_b: unidentified by homogeneous BAO; mathematical positive-component feasibility only, no BBN/CMB prior

training_validation_holdout_definition: Observed score fit uses all 13 ordered rows and full covariance. Subsequent matched flat-null calibration generated 1,200 fitted-null mock vectors and repeated the same finite profile-selection search.
covariance_order_and_overlap_treatment: Full released 13x13 covariance in exact mean-file order, including z=2.33 DH then DM. The compressed Ly-alpha BAO pair is retained only in this original vector; no overlapping Results IV block is appended.
hardware: CPU-only, one process and one BLAS/OpenMP thread; no GPU

numerical_checks.Gamma_zero_limit: unit predictions agree with baseline to max abs 1.11e-15; fitted score differs by 7.46e-13
numerical_checks.optimizer_status_and_physical_endpoint_a: retained; SciPy success flags separated from physical endpoint validity; 12/39 interaction starts reached invalid 1e80 penalty despite success=true

metric_definition: Delta chi2 = chi2(flat Gamma=0) - chi2(selected interacting profile); conditional finite profile score only.
uncertainty: No posterior interval. In the matched fitted-flat finite-search null, 256/1200 mock searches met/exceeded the observed Delta chi2 (exact CP95 0.19046–0.23762); this is not a p-value/evidence/discovery claim.
attempts_counted_in_search: 39 optimizer starts plus 41x41 shape grid/refinement for observed fit; null search is separately recorded in null_extension_1160_record.json and null_timing_40_record.json.
interpretation_and_limits: Modest profile gain is ordinary in its matched finite-search flat null. Strong Omega_m-rate degeneracy, BAO-only alpha degeneracy and missing full early-time/perturbation likelihood preclude a physical interacting-cosmology claim.
independent_reviewer: work/theory4/ independently reproduces the profile by scalar adaptive quadrature; work/data_audit3/ independently reconstructs all 1,200 mock vectors and checks eight saved fits.
review_disposition: Observed profile reproduced and independent null-stream audit PASS; physical early-time background sensitivity and predictive block-CV are separate experiments.
next_test: Use block-held-out prediction to determine whether the selected interaction predicts the z=2.33 BAO block; only pursue full CAMB if this and perturbation-source gates justify it.
